summary.title: Restore looping spinner and pull-to-refresh UI
changes: Loop indicator now shows a standard spinner and the text "looping" when active.
The previous animated capsule spinner was removed and replaced by a simpler spinner layout.
Pull-to-refresh now displays a spinner with the label "Forcing loop…" while forcing a loop.
Forcing a loop remains visible for at least one second and the dashboard shifts down to make room.
